title: Inquest into death of Roderick Sewap set for Oct. 20-24
article: A coroner's inquest will be held later this month into the death last year of a Saskatchewan man, Roderick Sewap.
Sewap, 43, died in hospital Aug. 31, 2013, six days after he was arrested in Denare Beach, Sask.
Following his arrest, he was placed in RCMP cells in Creighton. He had a seizure and was taken to hospital, first in Flin Flon, Man., and later in Saskatoon.
The public inquest with Coroner Alma Wiebe presiding has been scheduled for Oct. 20-24, at the Prospector Inn in Creighton, Sask.
The inquest can look into the medical cause of death and the manner of death. The coroner's jury may also make recommendations to prevent similar deaths in the future.
